broadcastModal.confirmCriticalBody: Critical severity places a real phone call to every registered authority contact, and sends real SMS if selected. This is not a drill.
broadcastModal.draftHelp: Fills the headline and message below from this alert's real data — Gemini, review before sending.
broadcastModal.waHelp: Formats this alert (bold headline, emoji severity marker, message, zone, emergency number) as plain text ready to paste into a real WhatsApp broadcast list — no gateway needed.

checkArea.nearby: Within {{radius}} km: {{high}} high, {{moderate}} moderate, {{low}} low-risk road stretches

high: In heavy rain, do not walk or drive on steep slopes or on roads below cliffs.
If you see cracks in the ground, leaning trees or poles, or a stream turning muddy suddenly, move away at once and tell your local authority.
If heavy rain goes on for many hours, move to safer, flatter ground away from the slope.
Keep a torch, a charged phone and important papers ready.
moderate: Be careful on steep roads and slopes, especially in heavy rain.
If you see cracks, leaning trees or muddy water, report it.
Follow warnings from your local authority.
low: Risk is lower here, but heavy rain can still cause landslides.
In heavy rain, stay away from steep cut slopes and road edges.
Report any cracks or small slips you see.
unscored: This stretch has no risk level yet. Be careful in heavy rain.
If you see cracks or a slide, tell your local authority.

checkArea.notFoundBody: Our map covers road stretches in Sikkim and the other north-east states where we have data. Try a bigger town nearby or a main road.
checkArea.disclaimer: The risk level is estimated from the shape of the land by a computer model, and compared with other places in the same state. It does not predict a particular landslide. Always follow warnings from your local authority.
